title: Hollis library summer reading wrap-up
brief: The Hollis Public Library wants a short summer reading wrap-up for the town newsletter, covering June to August 2026. 1248 children and teens registered, and 683 of them (54.7 percent) finished the program. Books logged by month: Jun 2340, Jul 3115, Aug 2870, which is 8325 in total, or 6.7 books per registered reader. Registered readers by age group: under 8, 402; 8 to 12, 561; 13 to 17, 285. The closing party on 2026-09-12 drew 310 people. Sections: "Summer at a glance", "Books logged by month" and "Readers by age group". July was the busiest month. People will read it on their phones.

edit.request: Correct July to 3215 books logged and update the total to 8425 and the average to 6.8 books per registered reader.
